summary: Booster 14 was caught by the tower on Flight 7 and became the first Super Heavy to fly twice, on Flight 9 with 29 flight-proven engines. On its second flight it broke up over the Gulf of Mexico during a descent experiment.

history.event: Launched on Flight 7; caught by the OLP-1 tower
First static fire of a flight-proven Super Heavy
Reflown on Flight 9; broke up over the Gulf near the start of its landing burn
